summary: No feedback release blocker found in the eight original-resolution captures and their real-clock motion, expiry and GUI activation evidence. The restrained text-only pickup stack and achievement PNG/title remain readable and separated from the hero and visible controls.

images.finding: Three distinct readable pickup rows sit above/right of the hero. Rune Ready is below/left with open space around it; no visible HUD or DEV-toggle contact.
At zoom1.35 the larger pickup stack remains clear of the hero and achievement. The bare icon/title remains legible without a new panel.
The full icon/title remains inside the left safe margin. Pickups occupy the clear area right of the hero and below the top HUD; DEV TOOLS remains unobscured.
Pickups move left of the right-edge hero; achievement stays farther left/below. All three amounts, the full title and the mine/context/bag controls remain visible.
The pickup stack moves above the low hero and the achievement sits left of the action area. Feedback does not cover the hero, HOME, bag or MINE controls.
All pickup text has gone; Rune Ready remains at the same visible location as the camera-moved capture, with no stale label residue.
Concurrent labels and achievement remain separated after camera movement. The hero, HUD and DEV toggle stay clear.
The three pickup rows remain coherent, legible and clear of the hero/HUD when no achievement is active.

source_findings: Pickup placement reserves the pulse/rise envelope, retains its offset while clear and excludes visible hero/HUD/DEV controls. Pickup-only placement follows the same owner.

Achievement placement retains its selected offset after pickup expiry and resets that offset for the next notification/current anchor. The icon/title, existing clock phases and at-least96x96 activation target remain.
Feedback placement does not change pickup quantities or lifetime owners; the inspected merged values are Waystone5, Memory Silk3 and Deep Alloy3.
scope_limits: Approval covers this exported DEV11 feedback presentation: three pickup kinds, Rune Ready, zoom0.8/1.0/1.15/1.35, edge placement, one sampled camera move, expiry and GUI activation. It is not whole-game visual approval.

The harness freezes gameplay beneath real feedback clocks, injects resource/achievement events and sets root logical content size to each1696x780 or1688x780 fixture. It uses collision-free interior positions; this is not an uninterrupted mining session or an exact production1280x720 logical-camera comparison.
Tapping evidence is an injected mouse press/release through the actual GUI input path, not a physical iPhone touch test.

Camera drag remains enabled. The report camera-relative reflow metric uses camera-node global position, so it is a proxy rather than exact screen-center-relative displacement. Judgment here uses the rendered toast rectangles, retained-placement records and inspected endpoint images.

This review did not play a motion video or evaluate every intervening animation pose, achievement title, resource combination or tool. Overall world joins, FPS, physical-device evidence and all-tool coverage remain open. No numeric overall quality rating is assigned.
